verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents a built-in Copilot that takes plain-English requests and configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports within the user's existing permissions. It offers Auto and Strict (ask-first) modes, per-person admin access, and a deletion block covering records and configuration, which together describe real task delegation with guardrails. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, in-depth docs on the range of record-level tasks Copilot can perform, since the evidence is homepage-level vendor claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests, inside the permissions you already have.
Ask what you would ask a sales analyst and get a report or a dashboard back.
Everyone starts in Auto and can switch to Strict in the chat whenever they want Copilot to ask first.
can block deletion entirely with a separate switch that covers records and configuration
